parsed_json.up: Select molecule identifiers and properties for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5260813. Return columns: molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), molecule_name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then compound_records to docs on doc_id. Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5260813'. LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno to include canonical_smiles with nulls allowed. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
